source.kaggle_context: Kaggle v12 timed out and later launches were blocked by weekly GPU quota, so this run used the approved remote L20 GPU.

scope.purpose: Complete the three-model Arabic-only MIRACL reranking comparison after E5 v13 and BGE-M3 v14.

interpretation: Arabic Triplet Matryoshka V2 completes the Arabic MIRACL reranking subset with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.673330.
It is substantially behind both BGE-M3 and E5 on this harder retrieval-style reranking slice, despite being the fastest of the three remote L20 runs.
The three-model MIRACL Arabic comparison now supports BGE-M3 as the strongest dense baseline for this specific reranking slice.

Together with the Namaa reranking result, the current picture remains task-dependent: E5 wins Namaa, BGE-M3 wins MIRACL Arabic, and Arabic Triplet is better treated as an STS/NLI or pure-Arabic semantic baseline rather than a broad reranking teacher.
This is baseline evidence, not an Arabic embedding SOTA claim.
next_experiment: Move to retrieval batches or begin training-data construction with task-family teachers: BGE-M3 for MIRACL-style retrieval/reranking, E5 for Namaa-style reranking and prompted STS/NLI, and Arabic Triplet for Arabic semantic/NLI data.
